howToUse.text: Wet your face with warm water to prepare your skin for cleansing.
Apply a small amount to your skin, massaging gently in circular motions.
Work the cleanser into a rich lather, focusing on areas that need extra nourishment.
Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water until all residue is removed.
Pat dry with a clean towel to help your skin retain its natural moisture.
Follow up with your favorite moisturizer to lock in hydration and softness.
